description.en:
Tunes the farm economy of any fillType and fruitType (base game, map or mods) from XML tables.
- Sell prices, seasonal price curves, buy prices of seed / fertilizer / fuel - Harvest yield and seed usage per crop - Works out of the box with the table shipped in the mod; prices hold on every economic difficulty - Your own overrides: modSettings/FS25_EconomyTuner/global.xml (all savegames) and savegameN.xml (one savegame), or a FS25_EconomyTuner.xml inside the savegame folder - Saved price history and price fluctuation curves are rescaled to the new prices - Console: etDump writes all prices, selling points and yields to CSV, etReload applies edited tables live
